title: Paid maternity and paternity leave - federal boundary
facts: There is no general federal law requiring every private employer in the United States to provide paid maternity or paternity leave.
Federal FMLA provides job-protected unpaid leave to eligible employees of covered employers, while some states and employers provide paid family or medical leave.
Federal employees can have separate paid parental leave rights under federal employment rules.
A specific paid-parental-leave answer therefore requires the worker's employer type and state.
